rationale: Papers 2502.16643 and 2412.02500 investigate the evolution and detection of primordial gravitational waves, providing insights into their role in the early universe. Paper 2603.05191 discusses the implications of scalar-induced gravitational waves, and 2407.11263 examines the impact of evolving dark energy on detecting primordial gravitational waves. These contributions provide substantive evidence but do not fully settle the question.
